answer: Charge every account a small rent each epoch, burned before any reward is credited, and retire accounts that miss two payments. A farm of N names must feed N meters every epoch, earning or not, so sleeper accounts hidden in reserve like caves in karst stop being free to keep. Like a comet shedding mass on each pass, a big farm bleeds fees steadily, while honest agents who earn well above the rent barely notice it. The rule is public and fixed; no plea in violet prose waives a missed payment.
